tei:div.tei:head: Lecha Dodi
tei:div.tei:p: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.
tei:div.tei:note: Each of the following stanzas is recited first by the Congregation and then by the Reader.
tei:div.tei:p: “Observe” and “Remember,” in a single command, the One God announced to us. The Lord is One, and his name is One, for fame, for glory and for praise.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:p: Come, let us go to meet the Sabbath, for it is a source of blessing. From the very beginning it was ordained; last in creation, first in God’s plan.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:p: Shrine of the King, royal city, arise! Come forth from thy ruins. Long enough have you dwelt in the vale of tears! He will show you abundant mercy.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:p: Shake off your dust, arise! Put on your glorious garments, my people, and pray: “Be near to my soul, and redeem it through the son of Jesse, the Bethlehemite.”

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:p: Bestir yourself, bestir yourself, for your light has come; arise and shine! Awake, awake, utter a song; the Lord’s glory is revealed upon you.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:p: Be not ashamed nor confounded. Why are you downcast? Why do you moan? The afflicted of my people will be sheltered within you; the city shall be rebuilt on its ancient site.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:p: Those who despoiled you shall become a spoil, and all who would devour you shall be far away. Your God will rejoice over you as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:p: You shall extend to the right and to the left, and you shall revere the Lord. Through the advent of a descendant of Perez we shall rejoice and exult.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.

tei:div.tei:note: Congregation rises and turns toward the door, as if to welcome a guest.
tei:div.tei:p: Come in peace, crown of God, come with joy and cheerfulness; amidst the faithful of the chosen people come O bride; come, O bride.

tei:p.tei:seg: Come, my friend, to meet the bride; let us welcome the Sabbath.
